description: This PHP source file defines the M2MRelationship class representing a many-to-many relationship within the SuiteCRM platform, including methods for managing relationship entries, generating SQL queries for relationship data, and handling internal relationship logic.

classes.name: M2MRelationship
classes.description: Represents a many-to-many relationship that is table-based, with methods for adding, removing, and querying relationship links, as well as handling relationship table structure and link integrity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the M2MRelationship class using the provided relationship definition.

methods.name: getLinkedDefForModuleByRelationship
methods.description: Finds and returns the link definition array for a specific module and relationship, handling cases with multiple links.

methods.name: getMostAppropriateLinkedDefinition
methods.description: Chooses the most appropriate link definition from multiple options based on matching name or id_name, with error logging.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new link between two beans for this relationship in the database; handles special cases for security groups and self-referencing relationships.

methods.name: getRowToInsert
methods.description: Generates a data row for inserting a new relationship link into the relationship table, including additional fields and role filtering.

methods.name: addSelfReferencing
methods.description: Adds a reversed relationship entry to support bidirectional access in self-referencing relationships.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the link between two beans from the relationship, handling security groups, relationship loading, and self-referencing relationships.

methods.name: removeSelfReferencing
methods.description: Removes the reversed relationship entry for self-referencing relationships.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads relationship data for a given link, returning related bean IDs.

methods.name: linkIsLHS
methods.description: Determines if the provided link is for the left-hand side of the relationship.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Builds an SQL query string to fetch related bean IDs for a relationship, with support for filtering and ordering.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Generates an SQL JOIN statement to include in queries for related beans via this relationship.

methods.name: getSubpanelQuery
methods.description: Builds a subpanel SQL query for fetching related records based on the focus bean's ID.

methods.name: getRoleFilterForJoin
methods.description: Constructs SQL filter clause for relationship role filtering.

methods.name: relationship_exists
methods.description: Checks if a relationship link exists between two beans by querying the relationship table.

methods.name: getAlternateKeyFields
methods.description: Returns the set of table fields that uniquely identify a relationship record, including role columns if applicable.

methods.name: getRelationshipTable
methods.description: Returns the name of the relationship table as defined in the relationship definition.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Provides the list of fields used in the relationship table, including default and custom fields.
